projects.name: NDDOT Statewide Transportation Improvement Program - Masterworks Projects - Line
projects.notes: NDDOT STIP projects from its Masterworks project system. Status is NOT useful (values only 'Migrated' or blank), so planned vs under way must be told from ConstructionYear (2025-2035, a few 2040/2055/2056) and ProposedBidDate. WorkType is a comma-separated list of short codes (e.g. 'LGHTG,RNDAB,SIGNG', 'AO>2'',MILLG', 'AGGBS,PCC'; 129 distinct combinations on the line layer) so it cannot be listed as a clean value set; ProgramCategory (Bridge, County, Emergency Relief, Other, Railroad, Rural, Safety, Transportation Alternatives, Urban) and InvestmentStrategies (codes such as MJREH, MNCPL, NWRCN, PREPL, SFIMP, STRRE) are cleaner. ProjectNumber is the federal-style project number. Some records are test data (e.g. ProjectName 'TEST MASTER REPOR TEST001'): filter names starting with TEST. work_type_values listed here are the ProgramCategory values, because WorkType is a code list.

projects.name: NDDOT Statewide Transportation Improvement Program - Masterworks Projects - Point
projects.notes: Point projects (bridges, intersections); same fields as the line layer. On points WorkType is sometimes spelled out (e.g. 'Drainage Improvements,Structure Restoration').

parcels_statewide.name: NDGISHUB Parcels (statewide parcel polygons + Parcels_TaxRoll table)
parcels_statewide.notes: All 53 counties are present. The polygon layer has NO owner name (its Ownership field is only a class: Private, County, State, Federal, Municipal, Railroad, Tribal...). Owner name, mailing address and values are in the separate table, layer 1 (Parcels_TaxRoll), which must be joined on UniqueGISID (county FIPS + GIS id, e.g. '38065-11117002'); 739,464 of 749,150 tax roll rows have an owner name. One polygon can have several tax roll rows. Owner2Name / Owner2MailingAddress hold a second owner. No restriction is stated on the service.

summary: Both work. NDDOT's STIP service gives lines and points with cost, bid date and construction year (status field is useless, a few test records). Statewide parcels have owners and mailing addresses, but in a tax roll table that has to be joined to the parcel polygons.
